_comment: Kiwix offline libraries. 'name' is the catalog ID; optional 'variant' selects maxi, nopic or mini. The preparer selects the newest matching filename and verifies exact size and SHA-256 from its metalink. Sizes below are estimates in GiB.

profiles.minimal: Essentials: medical encyclopedia, post-disaster survival, water, food and knots (~3 GiB)
profiles.recommended: Minimal + medical Wikipedia in PT/ES, iFixit, Appropedia and Energypedia (~8 GiB)
profiles.full: Recommended + Wikipedia without images in PT/EN/ES and English Wikivoyage (~77 GiB)
